pada:
aShTamo~adhyAyaH |
atha nasyavidhiH |
nasyasya niruktimAha -
nasyaM tatkathyate nIrairnAsAgrAhyaM yadauShadham | 
nAvanaM nasyakarmeti tasya nAmadvayaM matam || 1 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha nasyavidhiH | tatra nasyalakShaNaM dhIrairyat nAsAgrAhyamauShadhaM tat nasyaM kathyate | nAvanaM nasyakarma ceti tasya nAmadvayam || 1 ||

dI0 - atha pa~jcakarmapAriSeShyAnnasyavidhimadhyAyaM vyAKyAtuM pratijAnIte - nasyeti | auShadhaM kvAthasvarasasnehAdi, nasyamiti nAsayA dIyate iti nasyam | tasya nasyasya nAmadvayaM coktam, nAvanamekaM dvitIyaM nasyamiti || 1||

pada:
nasyaBedAnAha -
nasyaBedo dvidhA prokto recanaH snehanastathA | 
recanaM karShaNaM proktaM snehanaM bRuMhaNaM matam || 2 ||

vya_text: gU0- recanasnehananasyaBedadvayamAha - recanastathA snehana iti dvidhA nasyaBedaH proktaH kathitaH | tatra yadvirecanaM vAtakaPAdInAM CedanaM yat snehanaM tat bRuMhaNaM dhAtuvRuddhikaram || 2 ||

dI0 - nAsikayA dIyate yattat nasyaM tasya Bedo dviprakAraH, eko recanaH dvitIyaH snehanaH, recanaM karShaNaM snehanaM bRuMhaNam, upakramyasya dvitvAt | uktaM ca vAgBaTe - ‘upakramyasya hi dvitvAddvidhaivopakramo mataH | ekaH saMtarpaNastatra dvitIyaScApatarpaNaH’ iti | nanu vAgBaTena trividhaM nasyaM saviShayamuktaM tadyathA - ‘virecanaM SiraHSUlaM jADyaM spandagalAmaye | SoPagaNDakrimigranthiku- ShThApasmArapInase || bRuMhaNaM vAtaje SUle sUryAvarte svarakShaye | nAsA~asyaSoShe vAksaMge kRucCrabodhe~avabAhuke | SamanaM nIlikAvya~ggakeSadoShAkShirAjiShu || yathAsvaM yaugikaiH snehairyathAsvaM ca prasAdhitaiH | kalkakvAthAdiBiScAdyaM madhupaTvAsavairapi || bRuMhaNaM dhanvamAMsottharasAsRuksvapurairapi | SamanaM yojayetpUrvaiH kShIreNa salilena ca’ iti, tatkathamatra dvividhaM coktam ? ucyate - Samanasya bRuMhaNe~antarBAvAt | uktaM ca - ‘SamanaM yojayetpUrvaiH kShIreNa salilena ca’ iti | ata eva raviguptAdau pa~jcaBedAste yathA - ‘nasyaM SirovirekaSca pratimarSo~avapIDanam | j~jeyaM pradhamanaM caitannasyakarma tu pa~jcadhA’ iti | dRuDhabale tu dhUmo~adhiko~asti na ca Sirovireka iti | tadyathA - ‘nAvanaM cAvapIDaSca dhmApanaM dhUma eva ca | pratimarSaSca vij~jeyo nastakarma tu pa~jcadhA’ iti | kASmIrAstu ShaTprakAraM paThanti yathA - ‘avapIDaM pradhamanaM nasyaM recanatarpaNam | pratimarSaSca dhUmaSca nasyakarma tu ShaDvidham’ iti | te~apyatraivAntarBAvanIyAH| te tu granthakRutA evAgre spaShTatayoktAH | yathA - Sirorecane pradhamanAvapIDanasaMj~jAvantarBUtau, te tu karShaNatvAtkarShaNe~antarBUtau, pratimarShamarShau tu bRuMhaNentarBUtau, evaM dhUmo~api SodhanaSamanatvAt yathA svAntarBAvanIya iti susthitametat ||2||

pada:
nasyakarmakAlamAha -
kaPapittAniladhvaMse pUrvamadhyAparAhNake | 
dine tu gRuhyate nasyaM rAtrAvapyutkaTe gade || 3 ||

vya_text: gU0 - nasyadAne nasyakAlamAha - kaPapittavAtadhvaMse kaPapittavAtanASau krameNa dinasya pUrvamadhyaparAhNeke nasyaM gRuhyate | kaPanASArthaM dinasya pUrvaBAge, pittanASArthaM dinasya madhyaBAge, vAtanASArthaM dinasyAparaBAge | utkaTe gade rAtrAvapi nasyaM gRuhyate || 3 ||

dI0 - kaPapittAnilAnAM dhvaMse vRuddhilakShaNe kope, ‘sraMsudhvaMsu adhaHpatane’ ityasya rUpaM | kutra kopa ityata Aha - dinasya pUrvamadhyAhne~aparAhNake, tenA~ayamarthaH siddhaH - dinasya pUrvAhNe kaPakope, dinasya madhyAhne pittakope, dinasyAparAhNe vAtakope iti | athavA utkaTe gade rAtrAvapi nasyaM deyamiti | uktaM ca - ‘yathA doShodaye kAle rogiNe nAvanaM BiShag’ | iti ata eva svasthAsvasthaviShayasambandhena kAlA darSitAstantrAntare tadyathA - ‘SaraddhemantayoH svasthe pUrvAhNe saMprayojayet | varShAsu SItaje grIShme sAyaM madhyaMdine tathA’ iti ||3||

pada:
nasyaM yasminkAle tyAjyaM yaiSca tyAjyaM tAnAha -
nasyaM tyajedBojanAnte durdine cApatarpite | 
tathA navapratiSyAyI garBiNI garadUShitaH || 4 || 
ajIrNI dattabastiSca pItasnehodakAsavaH | 
kruddhaH SokABiBUtaSca tRuShArto vRuddhabAlakau || 5 || 
vegAvarodhI snAtaSca snAtukAmaSca varjavet |

vya_text: gU0 - yasminkAlai nasyaM tyAjyaM tadAha - durdine meGacCanne~ahni durdinam | apatarpaNe la~gGane, navapratiSyAyI navapratiSyAyavAn | garadUShitaH viShadUShitaH | pItasnehodakAsavaH pItaM sneham udakam AsavaM madyaM yena saH | vegAvarodhI mUtrapurIShakAvarodhI | spaShTamanyat || 4 || 5 ||

dI0 - durdine meGacCanne~ahni, apatarpite asantarpite puruShe | saMtarpaNaM dhAtuvRuddhikaraNArthaM tena dhAtubalo nasyena vidheyamiti tAtparyArthaH | cakArAdvAgBaToktAste yathA - ‘yojayennatu nAvanam | toyamadyagarasnehapItAnAM pAtumicCatAm || BuktaBaktaSiraHsnAtasnAtukAmasrutAsRujAm | navapInasavegArtasUtikASvAsakAsinAm || SuddhAnAM dattabastInAM tathA~anArtavadurdine| anyatrAtyayikAdvyAdheH’ iti | navapratiSyAyIti navatvaM dvividhanidAnaBedena | ekaM sadyojanakaM dvitIyaM doShacayapUrvakam | tatrAdyo yathA - ‘nArIprasa~ggaH Siraso~aBitApo dhUmo rajaH SItamatipratApaH | saMdhAraNaM mUtrapurIShayoSca sadyaH pratiSyAyanidAnamuktam’ iti | dvitIyo yathA -‘cayaM gatA mUrdhani mArutAdayaH pRuthak samastASca tathaiva SoNitam | prakupyamAnA vividhaiH prakopaNaistataH pratiSyAyakarA Bavanti hi’ iti | tena sadyonidAnajanakaH pratiSyAyaH so~api navaH pratiSyAya iti kecit | anye tvevamAhuH - ‘AmapakvaBedena pratiSyAyasya navapurANatve kathite | tenApi yaH AmasaMj~jakaH pratiSyAyaH so~api taruNatvena nasyaviShaye tyAjyaH na tu pakva iti BAvaH | garaM kRutrimaM viShaM tena vyAptaH | kevalaviShaprApte~avapIDasyoktatvAt | uktaM ca -‘cetovikAraviShABipannAnAM cUrNaM ShaDa~gguladvimuKayA nADyA deyam’ | anyacca - ‘viShABiGAtasaM- nyAsamUrcCAmohApatantrake | mahApasmAraSokArticintAkrodhAmayAdiShu || mAnaseShu ca rogeShu mUDhavyAkulacetasaH | saMj~jAprabodhahetvarthamavapIDaM pradApayet iti | bAlavRuddhayorapi utkaTadoSheShu nasyaM deyam, ‘BIrustrIkRuSabAlAnAm’ ityAdivakShyamANatvAt | snAtaH SirasnAta:, snAtukAmaSca ityanena pUrvaM vidhAya paScAtsnAnaM kuryAdityeke vyAKyAnayanti || 4 || 5 ||

pada:
nasyArhAnarhAnAha --
aShTavarShasya bAlasya nasyakarma samAcaret || 6 || 
aSItivarShAdUrdhvaM ca nAvanaM naiva dIyate |

vya_text: gU0 - yasya nasyaM deyaM tadapyAha - nAvanaM nasyaM | sugamam || 6 ||

dI0 - atha bAlavRuddhayornasyagrahaNAgrahaNaviShayaM darSayannAha - aShTavarShAdUrdhvaM nasyaM deyam | aShTavarShAdupari nasyakarma kuryAt | uktaM ca vAgBaTe - ‘na nasyamUnasaptAbde nAtItASItivatsare’ iti | aShTavarShAdarvAgapi doShodrekAdAtyayike vyAdhau bRuMhaNaM nasyaM deyam | uktaM ca - ‘BIrustrIkRuSabAlAnAM nasyata’ iti | evaM vRuddhasyA~aSItivarShasyApi j~jeyam || 6 ||

pada:
atha vairecanaM nasyamAha -
atha vairecanaM nasyaM grAhyaM tailaiH sutIkShNakaiH || 7 || 
tIkShNaBeShajasiddhairvA snehaiH kvAthai rasaistathA |

vya_text: gU0 - atha virecanasya vidhAnamAha – sugamam ||7||
dI0 - tailaiH sutIkShNakaiH sarShapAdijaiH tIkShNaBeShajasiddhaiH snehairvA | tIkShNadravyANi maricapippalISRu~ggaveraSoBA~jjanAdIni, taiH ye siddhA ye snehAH kvAthASca iti || 7 ||

pada:
virecanasya mAtrAmAha -
nAsikArandhrayoraShTau ShaT catvAraSca bindavaH || 8 || 
pratyekaM recane yojyA muKyamadhyAntyamAtrayA |

vya_text: gU0 - virecanasya pramANamAha - nAsikArandhrayoH CidrayoH dvayoH aShTau ShaT catvAraSca bindavaH muKyamadhyAntyAtmamAtrayA recane yojyAH | aShTau bindavaH muKyA mAtrA | ShaT madhyA mAtrA | catvAro bindavaH antyA kaniShThA mAtrA || 8 ||

dI0 - nAsikArandhrayoriti | dvayorapi nAsApuTayornasyaM yojanIyam | aShTAvityAdi | muKyamadhyAntyamAtrayA iti | aShTau bindavaH muKyamAtrA | recanasya ShaTbindavaH madhyamA | catvAraH antyA mAtrA hInamAtrA iti | uktaM ca - ‘catvAro bindavaH ShaT vA tathAShTau vA yathAbalam | Sirovirecane yojyA UrdhvajatruvikAriNAm’ iti | bindulakShaNaM vAgBaTe - ‘pradeSinya~ggulIparvadvayAnmagnasamuddhRutAt | yAvatpatatyasau bindurdaSAShTau ShaT krameNa te || marSasyotkRuShTamadhyonA mAtrAstA eva ca kramAt | bindudvayonAH kalkAdeH’ iti || 8 ||

pada:
nasyArthaM dravyANAM parimANamAha -
nasyakarmaNi dAtavyaM SANaikaM tIkShNamauShadham || 9 || 
hi~ggu syAdyavamAtraM tu mAShaikaM saindhavaM matam |
kShIraM caivAShTaSANaM syAtpAnIyaM ca trikArShikam ||10|| 
kArShikaM madhuraM dravyaM nasyakarmaNi yojayet |

vya_text: gU0 - nasyakarmaNi auShadhapramANamAha - nasyakarmaNIti spaShTam || 9 || 10 ||
dI0 - tIkShNamiti | maricapippalIhiMguSRu~ggavera-SoBA~jjanatRuvRutAdikam | madhuraM dravyaM sitApraBRutikam | SeShaM sugamam ||9|| 10||

pada:
atha SirovirecanaBedAnAha -
BavapIDapradhamanau dvau BedAvaparau smRutau || 11 || 
SirovirecanasyAtra tau tu deyaM yathAyatham |

vya_text: gU0 - virecanasya dvau BedAvaparAvapyAha - avapIDaH, pradhamanam, etau dvau virecanasya Bedau tau SirovirecanasthAne deyau || 11 ||
dI0 - atha Sirovirecanasya yau dvau avapIDapradhamanasaMj~jau tAvAha - yathAyathaM yathAdoShaM yathAmAtraM vA deyau | tayorvidhAnaM cAgre vakShyamANaM j~jeyam || 11 ||

pada:
athAvapIDapradhamanayoH svarUpamAha -
kalkIkRutAdauShadhAdyaH pIDito niHsRuto rasaH || 12|| 
so~avapIDaH samuddiShTastIkShNadravyasamudBavaH |
ShaDa~ggulA dvivaktrA yA nADI cUrNaM tathA dhamet ||13|| 
tIkShNaM kolamitaM vakravAtaiH pradhamanaM hi tat |

vya_text: gU0 – avapIDalakShaNamAha - kalkIkRutAditi sugamam || 12 || 13 ||

dI0 - kalkIkRutAdauShadhAdyaH raso niHsRutaH so~avapIDaH, kiMviSiShTaH ? pIDitaH AturanAsApuTe iti SeShaH | pradhamanaM tat, yat dvivakrA nADI ShaDa~ggulapramANA tayA cUrNaM pradhamet | kiMBUtam ? tIkShNaM tIkShNadravyakRutam | kolaM kolamAtram | vakravAtairiti vaidyamuKotthaiH kRutvA pradhamedityarthaH || 12 || 13 ||

pada:
Urdhvajatrugate roge kaPaje svarasaMkShaye || 14 || 
arocake pratiSyAye SiraHSUle ca pInase |
SoPA~apasmArakuShTheShu nasyaM vairecanaM hitam || 15 ||

vya_text: dI0 - Urdhvajatrugate virecanaM hitamiti | te ca grIvAgalAdirogA dRuDhabale~api - ‘stamBAntAH suptirudrAdyAH SleShmikA ye SirogadAH | SirovirecanaM teShu nasyakarma praSasyate’ iti | kaParoge iti | kAsaSvAsAdyAH | pratiSyAye nAsAsrAve pInase purANe iti ratnapraBAkAraH | cakradatte~api -‘SirovirecanaM dadyAt rogeShveteShu buddhimAn | gaurave SirasaH SUle jADye spande galAmaye || SoPagaNDakRumigranthikuShThApasmArapInase’ iti | anyatrA~apyuktaM - ‘Sirovirecanamapi SleShmaNA~aBivyAptatAlugalaSirasAM tathA~arocakaSirogauravaSUlapInasArdhAvaBedakakRumipratiSyAyA-pasmArAGrANAj~jAneShu cordhvajatrugadeShu Sirovirecanadravyasiddhena snehena’ iti || 14 || 15 ||

pada:
atha bRuMhaNanasyaviShayamAha -
BIrustrIkRuSabAlAnAM nasyaM snehena Sasyate |

vya_text: dI0 - snehena nasyamiti | bRuMhaNAKyam | yadA recananasyadAne pratipAditarogairaBiBUtAnAM BIrupraBRutInAM recanaM dAtavyaM tadA snehakRutaSirovirecanaM deyamityapi dvitIyo~arthaH sAmpradAyikaH ||

pada:
yeShu avapIDanaM yujyate tAnAha -
galaroge sannipAte nidrAyAM viShamajvare || 16 || 
manovikAre kRumiShu yujyate cAvapIDanam |

vya_text: gU0 - sugamam || 16 ||
dI0 - avapIDananasyasya viShayamAha - manovikAre iti | madamUrcCA~apasmArasaMnyAsonmAdaBUtonmAdAdiShu | kRumiSabdenAtra kRumijA rogA api grAhyAH ||16||

pada:
yeShu pradhamanaM yujyate tAnAha --
atyantotkaTadoSheShu visaMj~jeShu ca dIyate || 17 || 
cUrNaM pradhamanaM dhIraistaddhi tIkShNataraM yataH |

vya_text: gU0 - atyantotkaTadoSheShu mUrcCApasmArAdivisaMj~jeShu saMnyAsAdiShu || 17 ||

dI0 – pradhamananasyaviShayamAha - atyantotkaTadoSheShu cetovikAraviShABipanneShvityarthaH | evaMvidheShvanyeShvapi visaMj~jeShu madApasmArAdiShu | yatastIkShNataram atyantatIkShNadravyakRutaM | dhIrairiti vaidyaiH | dhIratvaM dRuDhaSAstrAByAsakarmatvena j~jeyam | tIkShNadravyato yathA -- 'pippalyaH SigrubIjAni viDa~ggamaricAni ca | avapIDaH praSasto~ayaM garacetovikAriNAm’ iti || 17 ||

pada:
idAnImavapIDanapradhamanayoH katipayayogAnAha -
guDAdinasyam |
nasyaM syAdguDaSuNThIByAM -

vya_text: dI0 - guDaSuNThIByAmeko yogaH |

pada:
pippalyAdinasyam |
pippalyAH saindhavena vA || 18 || 
jalapiShTena tenAkShikarNanAsASirogadAH |
manyAhanugalodBUtA naSyanti BujapRuShThajAH || 19 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atitIkShNataraM virecanamAha - nasyamiti sugamam || 18 || 19 ||

dI0 - pippalIsaindhavAByAM dvitIyaH | tena nasyenAkShikarNanAsASirogadAH naSyanti | gadaSabdo~atra pratyekamaBisambadhyate | tathA manyAhanugalodBUtA rogA iti SeShaH | BujapRuShThajA iti | BujajASca bAhukAsaSoShAdayaH, pRuShThajAH kubjabahirAmAdayaH | kecidvirecanaBedameva yogadvayamicCanti tadBedAdavapIDapradhamanayoruktatvAt || 18 || 19 ||

pada:
madhUkasArAdinasyam -
madhUkasArakRuShNAByAM vacAmaricasaindhavaiH |
nasyaM koShNajale piShTaM dadyAtsaMj~jAprabodhanam ||20|| 
apasmAre tathonmAde saMnipAte~apatantrake |

vya_text: gU0 - madhUkasAraH guDapuShpaH || 20 ||

dI0 - madhUkasArakRuShNAByAmeko yogaH | madhUko vRukShaviSeShaH, tasya sAraM madhyasthitakAShThaviSeSham | vacAmaricasaindhavaiH kRutvA paraH sakaladravyakRuto vA eka eva yogo vyavahArAt | SeShaM sugamam || 20 ||

pada:
tandrAyAM saindhavAdinasyam -
saindhavaM SvetamaricaM sarShapAH kuShThameva ca || 21 ||
bastamUtreNa piShTAni nasyaM tandrAnivAraNam |

vya_text: gU0 - atha tandrAyAM nasyam - SvetamaricaM prasiddham, yadvA SigrubIjam | bastamUtreNa || 21 ||
dI0 - tandrAyAM nasyamAha - Svetamaricamatra SigrubIjaM tatsaMj~jatvAt | bastaH CAgaH | piShTAnIti pUrvoktadravyANi iti SeShaH | teShAM tandrAnivAraNaM Bavati ||21 ||

pada:
maricAdinasyam -
rohitamatsyapittena BAvitaM saindhavaM vacA || 22 || 
maricaM pippalI SuNThI ka~gkolaM laSunaM puram |
kaTPalaM ceti taccUrNaM deyaM pradhamanaM budhaiH || 23 ||

vya_text: gU0 – pradhamananasyamAha - ka~gkolaM, maricaM, puro gugguluH, kaTPalam etatpradhamanacUrNaM tandrAdau deyamiti pUrveNa saMbandhaH ||22|| 23||

dI0 – pradhamanamAha - kaTPalaM vacA ca samatvena pUrvaM maricacUrNaM kRutvA paScAdrohitamatsyapittena BAvanA deyA, paScAccUrNaM kAryaM taccUrNaM pradhamanaM deyam | budhairityanena pariBAShoktarItyA pracArayedityaBiprAyaH || 22 || 23 ||

pada:
iti virecananasyakalpanA | 
atha bRuMhaNanasyakalpanAmAha –
atha bRuMhaNanasyasya kalpanA kathyate~adhunA | 
marSaSca pratimarSaSca dvau Bedau snehanI matau || 24 || 
marSasya tarpaNI mAtrA muKyA SANaiH smRutA~aShTaBiH | 
madhyamA ca catuHSANairhInA SANamitA smRutA ||25|| 
ekaikasmiMstu mAtreyaM deyA nAsApuTe budhaiH | 
marSasya dvitrivelaM vA vIkShya doShabalAbalam || 26 || 
ekAntaraM dvyantaraM vA nasyaM dadyAdvicakShaNaH | 
tryahaM pa~jcAhamathavA saptAhaM vA suyantritam || 27 || 
marSe Sirovireke ca vyApado vividhAH smRutAH | 
doShotkleSAtkShayAccaiva vij~jeyAstA yathAkramam ||28|| 
doShotkleSanimittAsu yu~jjyAdvamanaSodhanam | 
atha kShayanimittAsu yathAsvaM bRuMhaNaM hitam || 29 || 
SironAsAkShirogeShu sUryAvartArdhaBedake | 
dantaroge bale hIne manyAbahvaMsaje gade || 30 || 
muKaSoShe karNanAde vAtapittagade tathA | 
akAlapalite caiva keSaSmaSruprapAtane || 31 ||
yujyate bRuMhaNaM nasyaM snehairvA madhuradravaiH |

vya_text: gU0 - atha bRuMhaNanasya kalpanA - atheti sugamam | snehavyApat cikitsAmAha - marSe Sirovireke iti | vividhA vyApAdastadrogAH smRutAH | taddoShotkleSakShayAt dhAtukShayAt j~jeyAH | doShotkleSeShu kiM kartavyaM ? tadAha yu~jjyAdvamanaSodhanamiti yeShu bRuMhaNaM nasyaM dIyate tAnAha - manyA grIvA, aMsaH skandhaH, tadgade | snehairGRutAdyairmadhuraiH bRuMhaNaM yojyam || 24-31 ||

dI0 - atha virecananasyasya vidhAnAdikamaBidhAya saMprati bRuMhaNanasyasya BedapraBRutikaM darSayannAha - sugamam | tasya BedAnAha - marSaSceti | snehane bRuMhaNAKye nasye dvau BedAviti | ekaH marSaH, dvitIyaH pratimarSaH | atha marSasya BedamAtrAdikamAha - marSasya tarpaNasnehasya yA mAtrA sA aShTaBiH SANairmuKyA smRutA | madhyamA caturBiH SANairhInA SANapramANA | cakradatte - ‘nasyasya snaihikasyAtha deyAstvaShTau tu bindavaH | pratyekaSo nastakayornRuNAmiti viniScayaH || SuktiSca pANiSuktiSca deyA~atra kuSalairnaraiH’ iti | binduparimANamuktaM vAgBaTe -‘pradeSinya~ggulIparvadvayAnmagnasamuddhRutAt | yAvatpatatyasau bindurdaSAShTau ShaTkrameNa te | marSasyotkRuShTamadhyonA mAtrAstA eva ca kramAt | bindurdvayonAH kalpAdeH’ iti | suSrute~api nasyapramANaM tu ‘aShTau bindavaH pradeSinIparvadvayaparisrAvo binduH, eShAtra prathamA mAtrA, dvitIyAtra SuktiH, tRutIyA pANiSuktiH etAstisro mAtrA yathAbalaM prayojyA Bavanti’ iti | SuktiparimANaM tu ‘dvAtriMSadbiMdavaScApi SuktirityaBidhIyate | dve SuktI pANiSuktiSca deyA~atra kuSalairnaraiH’ iti | snehanasyaM na gilet kiMtu tyajedeva | tathAhi suSrutaH - ‘snehanasyaM na copagiletkathaMcit’ iti | athaitatparimANamekavAraM bahuvAraM vA deyamiti Sa~gkAyAM samAdhAnamAha - ekaiketi | marSasya iyaM mAtrA pUrvoktA ekaikasminnAsApuTe deyA | etenaikavAraviShayaM darSitam | yaduktaM - pratyekaSo nastakayornRuNAmiti viniScayaH’ iti |‘vA’ athavA doShabalAbalaM dRuShTvA dvivAraM trivAraM vA saiva mAtrA deyA iti ||
nasyadAnakAlamaryAdAmAha -- ekAntaramiti | vicakShaNo vaidyaH | ekAntaram ekadivasAntaraM vA prayojya saptAhaM yAvat paramadAnena sAtmIBavati | atrA~api punaHpunariti SeShaH | yaduktaM - ‘saptAhaM tu paraM deyaM miSritasya punaHpunaH’ iti | vAgrahaNena navamadivasAdupari sAtmyaM Bavati ityuktatvAt | tathAhi - ‘paraM navAhamUrdhvaM tu navAhAtsAtmyatAM vrajet’ iti || marSe doShotkleSAdvyApado Bavanti ityata Aha - marSe iti | atha tayoScikitsAmAha - doShotkleSa iti | vamanaSodhanamiti SirovirecanAdirUpaM nasyam | yathAsvamiti yathAdoShaM | bRuMhaNamiti snaihikaM nasyaM | bRuMhaNanasya viShayamAha - Sira iti | SirorogAdiShu bRuMhaNaM nasyaM yujyate || 24-31 ||

pada:
ku~gkumanasyam|
saSarkaraM paya:piShTaM BRuShTamAjyena ku~gkumam || 32 || 
nasyaprayogato hanyAdvAtaraktaBavA rujaH |
BrUSa~gKAkShiSiraHkarNasUryAvartArdhaBedakAn || 33 ||

vya_text: gU0 - sa yathA - saSarkaraM sitAsahitaM payaH dugdham, Ajyena GRutena ku~gkumaM keSaraM piShTvA tannasyaprayogataH vAtaraktAdirujaH hanyAt || 32 || 33 ||

dI0 – kuMkumanasyamAha - SarkarA sitopalA, kuMkumaM keSaraM kASmIrajam | Ajyena GRutena kRutvA GRutena BarjayitvA saSarkaramiti samAnaSarkaram | tadanu kShIreNa piShTvA nasyaM deyam | tadGRutaM nasyaprayogataH BrUSaDKAdirujaH hanyAt iti || 32 || 33 ||

pada:
anyabRuMhaNanasyamAha -
nasyaM syAdaNutailena tathA nArAyaNena vA | 
mAShAdinA vA sarpirBistattadBeShajasAdhitaiH || 34 ||

vya_text: gU0 – anyadapyAha - aNutailena atasItailena | sarpirBirGRutaiH tadroganASakairauShadhaiH sAdhitaM tasya bRuMhaNaM syAt || 34 ||

dI0 - athA~aparANi bRuMhaNanasyAdInyAha - aNutaileneti | aNutailena nasyaM vAtaraktaBavA rujo hanyAdityatra saMbandhaH | ‘gavAM SakRut kvAthavipakvamuttamaM hitaM ca tailaM timireShu nasyataH | GRutaM tathA kevalameva paittike tathANutailaM pavanAsRugucCayo’riti | aNutailaM tu vAtavyAdhicitsoktamanyatra j~jAtavyaM | keShAMcit j~jApanArthaM yathA ‘tilapIDanopakaraNakAShThAnyAhRutyAnalpakAlatailaparipItA-nyaNUni kANDaSaH parikalpyAtikuTya ca mahAkaTAhe pAnIyenAsrAvya kvAthayet | tataH snehamastudRuShatsarakapANyoranyatareNAdAya vAtaGnauShadhapratIvApaM snehapAkakalkena vipacet |#foot@- vAgBaTe tu - ‘jIvantI-jala-devarArujalada-tvak-sevyagopIhimam | dArvItvak-madhuka-plavA-guruvarI puNDrAhva- bilvotpalam|| dhAvanyau suraBiH sthire kRumiharaM patraM truTiM SeNukam | ki~jjalkaM kamalAdbalAM SataguNe divye~amBasi kvAthayet || tailAdrasaM daSaguNaM pariSoShya tena tailaM pacet salilakena daSaiva vArAn | pAke kShipecca daSame samaBAgadugdhaM vaidyA mahAguNamuSantyaNutailametat’ iti varNitam |#
 etadaNutailamupadiSanti vAtarogeShviti’ | nArAyaNena taileneti SeShaH | mAShAdineti | atrA~api tailena sambandhaH | nArAyaNatailaM mAShatailaM ca vAtavyAdhicikitsoktaM j~jAtavyaM tattadBeShajasAdhitaiH sarpirBiriti | yAni yAni dravyANi vAtaraktahRunnABicakShuHSiraHkarNarogANAM vihitAni taistairdravyai- reva sAdhitAni sarpIMShi tatra tatra yojyAnItyaBiprAyaH || 34 ||

pada:
doSheShu snehavyavasthA |
tailaM kaPe syAdvAte ca kevale pavane vasAm | 
dadyAnnasyaM sadA pitte sarpirmajjAnameva ca || 35 ||

vya_text: gU0 - rogaBedena tailAdInAM nasyaBedamAha - tailamati | sugamam || 35 ||

dI0 - atha catuHsnehasya doShaviSeSheNopAdeyatvamAha - tailaM kaPe syAdvAte ceti | atra savAte iti pAThAntaraM, kevale vAte svatantre atrANutailameva pradhAnaM | yaduktaM ‘caturvidhastu snehasya vidhireShaH prakIrtitaH | SleShmasthAnavirodhitvAtteShu tailaM viSiShyata’ iti || 35 ||

pada:
mAShAdinasyam |
mAShA~atmaguptArAsnABirbalArubukarohiShaiH | 
kRuto~aSvagandhayA kvAtho hi~ggusaindhavasaMyutaH || 36 || 
koShNo nasyaprayogeNa pakShAGAtaM sakampanam | 
jayedarditavAtaM ca manyAstamBApabAhukau || 37 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha pakShavAtArditAdau nasyam - mASho~annaviSeShaH, AtmaguptA kapikacCUH, balA prasiddhA, rubukaH eraNDaH, rohiShaH kattRuNaH, aSvagandhA hayagandhA koShNaH kkAtha: sakampanaM kampavAtaM hanyAt || 36 || 37 ||

dI0 - athAparamapi yogamAha - AtmaguptA kapikacCU: rAsnA suraBI balA sAmaSabdavAcyA rubuka eraNDaH | rohiSho gandhatRuNaH aSvagandhayA saha militvA kvAthaH hi~ggusaindhavayoH prakShepaH | tadvyavahArato hi~ggu raktikAdvayaM saindhavaM mAShaikaM prakShepaH | jayedarditavAtaM ceti cakAragrahaNAt karNanAdarujAyAM praSasta iti prasiddhiH | yaduktaM - ‘mAShabalASUkaSimbIkattRuNarAsnorubUkASvagandhAnAM | kvAtho nasyanipIto rAmaThalavaNAnvitaH koShNaH | apaharati pakShAGAtaM manyAstamBaM sakarNarujam | durjayamarditavAtaM saptAhAjjayati cAvaSya’miti | iti marSavidhiH || 36 || 37 ||

pada:
atha pratimarSamAha -
pratimarSasya mAtrA tu dvidvibindumitA matA |
pratyekaSo nastakayoH sneheneti viniScitam || 38 || 
snehe granthidvayaM yAvannimagnA coddhRutA tataH |
tarjanIyaM sravedbinduM sA mAtrA bindusaMj~jitA ||39|| 
evaMvidhairbindusaMj~jairaShTaBiH SANa ucyate |
sa deyo marSanasye tu pratimarSo dvibindukaH ||40|| 
samayAH pratimarSasya budhaiH proktAScaturdaSa |
praBAte dantakAShThAnte gRuhAnnirgamane tathA ||41|| 
vyAyAmAdhvavyavAyAnte viNmUtrAnte~a~jjane kRute | 
kavalAnte BojanAnte divAsuptotthite tathA || 42|| 
vamanAnte tathA sAyaM pratimarSaH prayujyate |
IShaducCikkanAtsneho yadA vaktraM prapadyate || 43 || 
nasye niShiktaM taM vidyAtpratimarSaM pramANataH |
ucCindanna pibeccaitanniShThIvenmuKamAgatam || 44 || 
kShINe tRuShNAsyaSoShArte bAle vRuddhe ca yujyate |
pratimarSena SAmyanti rogAScaivordhvajatrujAH ||45|| 
valIpalitanASaSca balamindriyajaM Bavet |

vya_text: gU0 - atha pratimarSamAha - pratimarSasya nasyamAtrA dvitribindumitA kathitA | pratyekaSo nAsikayoH snehena GRutena | bindumAtrAmAha - evaMvidhairbindusaMj~jairaShTaBiH SANa ucyate | sneheti sugamaM | pratimarSanasyasamayamAha - eShu caturdaSasamayeShu pratimarSe nasyaM prayujyate | dhamanasya niShiktalakShaNamAha - IShaducCikkanAt IShat CikkanAt yadA snehaH vaktraM muKaM prapadyate nasye niShiktaM dattaM pratimAShaM pramANaM tatastadA taM ucCiShTaM vidyAt | tatra kiM kuryAdityAha - ucCiShTaM na pibetpratimarSam | anyeShu keShu yujyate tAnapyAha - kShINe dhAtukShINe tathA tRuShNA AsyaM muKaM tacCoShArte bAle tathA vRuddhe ca yujyate pratimarSena ete SAmyanti tathA UrdhvatrujA grIvAmUlordhvajAH SAmyanti tathA valIpalito yujyate valI tvakSaithilye palitaM keSaSauklyaM tathA indriyajaM balaM Bavet || 38-45 ||

dI0 - ‘pratyekaSo nastakayorupaiti vadanaM yathA | tathaitairvihitaH sneho naivAntaH saMprapadyate’ iti pAThAntaram | etaiH padArthairvirahitaH sneho yadA Bavati tadAntaH na prApnoti iti BAvaH | ayaM pAThaH kenApyatra paThitaH || 38-45 ||

pada:
atha palite nasyam |
biBItanimbakamBArI SivA SeluSca kAkinI ||46|| 
ekaikatailanasyena palitaM naSyati dhruvam |

vya_text: gU0 - biBItaM biBItakamajjAnaM nimbaM nimbabIjaM kamBArI prasiddhA, tasyA bIjaM, SivA harItakI majjA, SeluH SAKoTakamajjA, kAkinI kikaIbIjam eShAm ekaikatailalasyena palitaM naSyati || 46 ||

pada:
atha nasyagrahaNe nasyavidhimAha --
atha nasyavidhiM vakShye nasyagrahaNahetave || 47 || 
deSe vAtarajomukte kRutadantaniGarShaNam | 
viSuddhaM dhUmapAnena svinnaBAlagalaM tathA || 48 || 
uttAnaSAyinaM kiMcitpralambaSirasaM naram |
AstIrNahastapAdaM ca vastrAcCAditalocanam || 49 || 
samunnamitanAsAgraM vaidyo nasyena yojayet |
koShNamacCinnadhAraM ca hematArAdiSuktiBiH || 50 || 
SuktyA vA yatra yuktyA vA plotairvA nasyamAcaret | 
nasyeShvAsicyamAneShu Siro naiva prakampayet || 51 || 
na kupyenna praBASheta nocCidenna hasettathA |
etairhi vihitaH sneho naivAntaH saMprapadyate || 52 || 
tataH kAsapratiSyAyaSiro~akShigadasaMBavaH |
SRu~ggATakamaBiplAvya sthApayenna gileddravam || 53 ||

vya_text: gU0 - vAtarajomukte deSe sthAne kRutadantaniGarShaNaM kRutadantadhAvanaM, dhUmapAnena viSuddhaM, tathA svinnaBAlagalaM dhUmapAnena | yadvA sveditaBAlagalaM tathA uttAnaSAyinaM naraM nasyena yojayet | plotaM plotakaM | spaShTamanyat | nasyaniShikte kathaM niShThIvedityAha - nocCidenna kiMcitkShodayet | etaiH kopAdiBiH vihitaH kRutaH nasyaH antarmadhye na prapadyate tataH kAsAdayaSca BavantItyAha - pratiSyAyo nAsAsrAvaH | tataH koShAdeH SRu~ggATakAdisthApane SikShitamAha - SRu~ggATakaM nAsAvaMSaM BrUmadhyaM AplAvya nasyaM draveNAplutya na sthApayet | dravaM na gilet, spaShTamanyat || 47-53 ||

pada:
atha nasyadhAraNArthaM mAtrAsaMKyAmAha - 
pa~jca sapta daSaiva syurmAtrA nasyasya dhAraNe |

vya_text: di0 - pa~jcasaptAdisaMKyAgrahaNaM doShAdibalAbalaviShayam | mAtrApramANaM tu vAgBaTe -‘yAvatparyeti hastAgraM dakShiNaM jAnumaNDalam | nimeShonmeShakAlena samaM mAtrA tu sA smRutA’ iti ||

pada:
nasyadAnAnantaraM kiM kartavyam ? ityata Aha -
upaviSyAtha niShThIvennAsAvaktragataM dravam || 54 || 
vAmadakShiNapArSvAByAM niShThIvetsaMmuKe na hi |
nIte nasye manastApaM rajaH krodhaM ca saMtyajet ||55|| 
SayIta nidrAM tyaktvA ca prottAno vAkSataM naraH | 
tathA vairecanaScAnte dhUmo vA kavalo hitaH || 56 ||

vya_text: gU0 - nasye nIte yatkartavyaM tadAha - rajo dhUli: | yathA dhUmapraveSo na Bavet | sa pItanasya uttAnaH san vAkSataM Bavet | virecananasyAnte dhUmaH kavalaSca hitaH deyaH || 54-56 ||

dI0 - athaSabda Anantarye | nasyAnantaraM nAsAdidravam upaviSya niShThIvet | kAByAM ? vAmadakShiNapArSvAByAM | kathaM ? sammuKaM nahi niShThIvet | tiryak niShThIvanAt samyagdravanirgamo Bavati ityarthaH | niShThIvanAnantaraM kartavyamAha - nIte iti | krodhaM ceti | caSabdastantrAntaroktagrahaNArthaH | uktaMca - ‘rajodhUmamanastApasnAnakrodhAdivarjayet’ iti | vAkSataM gurvakSharoccAraNaSatamAtram | vairecananasyAnte iti SirovirecanasyottarakAlaM, rajo dhUliH, dhUmo vA kavalo hitaH iti | dhUmaH snigdhAdiragre vakShyamANaH, kavalaH prAguktalakShaNaH hitaH pathyastasmAtkartavya ityarthaH || 54-56 ||

pada:
atha nasye kati lakShaNAni Bavanti ? ityAha -
nasye trINyupadiShTAni lakShaNAni prayogataH | 
SuddhihInAtiyogAni viSeShAcCAstracintakaiH ||57||

vya_text: gU0 - SuddhyAdiBedena nasye lakShaNamAha - nasye iti | spaShTam || 57 ||
dI0 - prayogata iti nasyaprayogAt | SAstracintakaiH SAstraM vaidyakaSAstraM tasya cintakAH vicArakA iti || 57 ||

pada:
nasyaSuddhilakShaNamAha -
lAGavaM manasaH SuddhiH srotasAM vyAdhisaMkShayaH | 
cittendriyaprasAdaSca SirasaH SuddhilakShaNam || 58 ||

vya_text: gU0 – SuddhimAha - lAGavaM SirasaH manasaH SuddhirmUrcCAdyasrAvatvaM srotasAM SuddhiH vyAdhisaMkShayaH, cittaprasAdaSca SirasaH SirorogAdinASaH | prasannatvaM SirasaH SuddhiH idaM SuddhilakShaNam || 58 ||

dI0 - lAGavamiti SarIrasya | SarIragrahaNenaiva SirograhaNe labdhe punaH SirograhaNaM dehasyordhvamUlAdapi lAGavapratipAdanArtham | manasaH SuddhiH manaso hlAdakatvAt manasaH SuddhiH | tathA srotasAM SuddhiH srotAMsi prANadhAtumalAmBo~annavAhinAM SuddhatA | tathA cittendriyaprasAdaSca manasaH indriyANAM cakShurAdInAM prasannatA | tathA vyAdhisaMkShayaH vyAdhayo nasyasAdhyA rogAH | tantrAntare tu - ‘prasannadRuShTirdRuDhadantakeSaH SaSA~gkavakraH palitairvihInaH | pikABikaNThaH kamalAsya gandho nasyopasevI BavatIha martyaH’ iti | anyatrApyuktam - ‘indriyANAM ca vaimalyaM kuryAdAsyasugandhatAm | hanudantaSirogrIvAtrikabAhUrasAM balam || valIpalitaKAlityaM vya~ggAnAmapyasaMBavam iti || 58 ||

pada:
atha hInaSuddherlakShaNamAha -
kaNDUpadehau gurutA srotasAM kaPasaMsravaH |
mUrdhni hInaviSuddhestu lakShaNaM parikIrtitam || 59 ||

vya_text: gU0 - hInaviSuddheH Sirasi lakShaNamAha - upadeho liptatA, gurutA gurutvam, srotasAM nAsAdInAm | kaPasaMsrAvaH | hInaSuddheH alpaSuddheH || 59 ||

dI0 - atha hInaSuddherlakShaNAnyAha - hInaviSuddheH Sirasi lakShaNaM | kiM tat | kaNDUpadehAviti muKanAsikAdInAm upadehaH SleShmaNABiliptamiva muKaM BavatIti | gurutA cAtra SirasaH | srotasAM kaPAdivahAnAM kaPasaMsrava iti pracuraSleShmasaMBava iti tAtparyArthaH || 59 ||

pada:
atiSayaSuddhasya lakShaNamAha -
mastulu~ggAgamo vAtavRuddhirindriyaviBramaH |
SUnyatA SirasaScApi mUrdhni gADhaM virecite ||60||

vya_text: gU0 - mastulu~ggAgamo mastikAByantarAt lu~ggo mAtulu~ggaH tajjalasadRuSo niHsAraH vAtavRuddhiH, indriyaviBramaH, SirasaH SUnyatA, idaM gADhavirecitaSiraso lakShaNAm ||60 ||

dI0 – ativirecitalakShaNamAha - mUrdhni Sirasi | ativirecite sati mastulu~ggAgamAdayo Bavanti | mastulu~ggaM mastiShkam, vAtavRuddhirityatra vAtaduShTiriti vA pAThaH | indriyaviBramaH indriyanASaH, SirasaH SUnyatA mastakaSUnyatA | ‘SUnyatA manasaScA~api’ iti pAThAntaram || 60 ||

pada:
hInAtiSuddhau cikitsAmAha -
hInAtiSuddhe Sirasi kaPavAtaGnamAcaret | 
samyak viSuddhe Sirasi sarpirnasye niShecayet ||61||

vya_text: gU0 - hInAtiSuddhyAdau kriyAmAha - kaPavAtaGnaM nasyamAcaret || 61 ||
dI0 - hInAtiSuddhe Sirasi kaPavAtaGnaM kramAdAcarediti j~jeyam | hInaSuddhe Sirasi kaPaGnam, atiSuddhe vAtaGnaM, samyakSuddhe Sirasi, nasyena samyak Suddhe sarpiryojayedityarthaH || 61 ||

pada:
atisnigdhalakShaNacikitsAmAha - 
kaPaprasekaH Siraso gurutendriyaviBramaH | 
lakShaNaM tadatisnigdhe tatra rUkShaM pradApayet || 62 || 
BojayeccAnaBiShyandi tasyAcArikamAdiSet |

vya_text: gU0 - atisnigdhe lakShaNamAha - indriyaviBramaH BrAntitvam ayathArthaSaktiH, atisnigdhe idaM lakShaNam | tatra rUkShamavacArayet | nasye~avarukShaM dApayet | nasye BojanAcAramAha - anaBiShyandi mahiShIdadhyAdi nasyAcArikaM nasye ye SiShTA Acaranti tadAcaret || 62 ||

dI0 - atisnigdhe etallakShaNam | tatkim ? kaPaprasekAdi kaPaprasekaH srAvaH, SirasaH gurutA SirojADyam, indriyANAM cakShurAdInAM viBramaH | rUkSham annaM pradApayet | anaBiShyandi srotasAM yallepakaraM na Bavati etamAcArikam AdiSet | uktaM ca vAgBaTe - ‘uShNodakopacArI syAdbrahmacArI kShapASayaH | na vegarodhI vyAyAmakrodhaSokahimAtapAn || pravAtapAnayAnAdhvaBAShyAByAsanasaMsthitiH | nIcAtyuccopadhAnAhasvapnadhUmarajAMsi ca’ iti || 62 ||

pada:
prakaraNArthamupasaMharati -
vamanaM recanaM nasyaM nirUhaScAnuvAsanam | 
etAni pa~jca karmANi kathitAni munISvaraiH ||63|| 
iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadharAcAryeNa viracitAyAM
SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAmuttaraKaNDe nasyavidhi-
rnAmAShTamo~adhyAyaH ||

vya_text:
gU0 – pa~jcakarmasaMKyAmAha - recanaM virekaH, nirUhaM nirUhaNabastiH | anuvAsanabastiH | nanu bastikarma ekavidhaM Bavati tatkathaM dvividham ? ucyate - anuvAsanasya nirUhasya ca pRuthakkaraNAt || 63 ||
iti SrIkASIrAmamiSrakRutAyAM SAr~ggadharagUrtha-
dIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe nasya-
varNanIyo~adhyAyaH ||

dI0 - tAni kAni vamanadIni || 63 ||
iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaprakASavaidyaBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe nasyavidhirnAmA-
ShTamo~adhyAyaH ||
